# pidginhost_bucket_credentials (Resource)

The S3 access key and secret key of a bucket, read with the API's `credentials/reveal` action.

~> **The keys are stored in the Terraform state in plain text.** They are marked sensitive, so they are hidden in plan output, but anyone who can read the state can read them. Use an encrypted remote state backend (or OpenTofu state encryption) and restrict access to it.

Changing `rotation_trigger` (to any new value) rotates the keys with `credentials/rotate`; the old keys stop working. Every refresh reveals the current keys, so keys rotated outside Terraform are picked up. Destroying this resource only removes the keys from the state; it does not revoke them.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pidginhost_bucket" "backups" {
  name     = "backups"
  quota_gb = 100
}

# The keys end up in the Terraform state: keep the state encrypted and access-controlled.
resource "pidginhost_bucket_credentials" "backups" {
  bucket_id = pidginhost_bucket.backups.id

  # Change this value to rotate the keys.
  rotation_trigger = "2026-10"
}

output "backups_access_key" {
  value     = pidginhost_bucket_credentials.backups.access_key
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bucket_id` (String) ID of the bucket.

### Optional

- `rotation_trigger` (String) Any string. Any change to it after creation (including setting or removing it) rotates the keys, for example `rotation_trigger = time_rotating.keys.id` or a date. Creating or importing the resource never rotates.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `access_key` (String, Sensitive) S3 access key ID.
- `bucket` (String) Full bucket name.
- `endpoint` (String) S3 endpoint URL.
- `id` (String) Same as `bucket_id`.
- `region` (String) S3 region.
- `secret_key` (String, Sensitive) S3 secret access key.

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Read operations occur during any refresh or planning operation when refresh is enabled.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import the credentials of a bucket by the bucket's ID.
terraform import pidginhost_bucket_credentials.backups 123
```
